title: Daily Security Intelligence Briefing — November 25, 2026
summary: Federal agencies face acute scrutiny following intrusions into an unclassified CIA/ODNI intelligence system and the US Treasury's FinCEN (CyberScoop, The Record). Simultaneously, active exploitation targets critical flaws in VMware vCenter, Drupal Core, Check Point Security Management servers, and the Hex.pm package registry (The Hacker News, BleepingComputer, Help Net Security).

tier1.title: 1. Unclassified intel system hit by hackers, affecting CIA, ODNI

fields.label: Source & Article Link
fields.value: CyberScoop

fields.label: Technical Severity / Domain
fields.value: Government & National Security / Data Breach (Active Investigation)

fields.label: Why You Must Read This
fields.value: Threat actors breached an unclassified open-source intelligence (OSINT) analysis platform shared by the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence. While officials state the exposure was limited to unclassified data and did not touch classified networks, the intrusion forced a temporary service disruption. This coincides with a wave of federal cyber incidents, including an ongoing investigation at the FBI's National Crime Information Center and leadership changes at the Office of the National Cyber Director.

fields.label: Recommended Immediate Action
fields.value: Federal and intelligence contractors should review interconnected OSINT feeds for potential credential exposure and monitor for targeted follow-on phishing.

tier1.title: 2. Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after cybersecurity incident

fields.label: Source & Article Link
fields.value: The Record from Recorded Future News

fields.label: Technical Severity / Domain
fields.value: Government & Financial Sector / Intrusion (Service Disruption)

fields.label: Why You Must Read This
fields.value: The US Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) took several systems offline following unauthorized access to a subset of its infrastructure. FinCEN is critical to tracking illicit finance, anti-money laundering, and national security financial intelligence. The containment measures temporarily disrupt certain regulatory reporting workflows while forensic teams assess the blast radius.

fields.label: Recommended Immediate Action
fields.value: Financial institutions interacting with FinCEN portals should verify API and filing endpoint statuses and monitor Treasury advisories for IOCs.

tier2.title: 1. VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Virtualization & Cloud Infrastructure

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Broadcom released VMSA-2026-0011, its third critical VMware security bundle in a week, addressing 23 vulnerabilities across ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer. The primary flaw, CVE-2026-123903 (CVSS 9.8), is an authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) that has been exploited in the wild as a zero-day.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: CVE-2026-123903 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication via vmdir.; Organizations must apply VMSA-2026-0011 patches immediately and audit vCenter logs for unauthorized administrative sessions.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: A malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server may exploit this issue to bypass authentication.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 2. Hackers Compromise 24 Check Point Management Servers in Suspected AI-Driven Attack Campaign

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Network & Perimeter Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: GreyNoise is tracking an active intrusion campaign (GT13) that compromised 24 Check Point Security Management servers across 22 global organizations in the financial, energy, and government sectors. The threat actor leveraged AI-driven offensive tooling and abused CVE-2026-16232 (SmartConsole authentication bypass) to exfiltrate firewall databases, steal internal CA certificates, and unload security policies.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Attackers patched compromised servers post-exploitation to lock out rival threat actors while maintaining persistent access.; Administrators must apply Check Point Jumbo Hotfixes (R81.20 Take 158, R82 Take 118, R82.10 Take 36) and restrict Trusted Clients to specific admin IPs.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: An unknown threat actor has been using artificial intelligence (AI)-driven offensive tooling in a campaign targeting Check Point Security Management servers, impacting 22 distinct organizations across the world.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 3. Hackers Exploited CVSS 10.0 Hex.pm RCE Flaw to Compromise 6 Package Registry Servers

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Software Supply Chain

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Attackers exploited a decade-old unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-129514, CVSS 10.0) in Hex.pm, the primary package registry for Elixir and Erlang, executing OS commands across six production servers. Maintainers deployed a fix within 15 minutes of the initial 69 exploit requests and rotated server credentials.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Audits confirmed no packages were modified, though unlogged database reads of email addresses, password hashes, and 2FA secrets cannot be ruled out.; Elixir and Erlang developers should rotate their Hex.pm API keys and credentials immediately.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: An attacker ran operating system commands on Monday on six production servers of Hex.pm, the package registry that Elixir and Erlang developers fetch their dependencies from.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 4. Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Web Application Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: The Drupal security team and CISA confirmed active in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-132165, a critical flaw in the Drupal core installer (/core/install.php) discovered by an Anthropic scanner. Unauthenticated attackers are abusing the vulnerability to force live site reinstallations, leading to full site takeovers and remote code execution.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: CISA added CVE-2026-132165 to the KEV catalog with a three-day remediation deadline for federal agencies.; Upgrade immediately to Drupal 10.6.22, 11.3.22, or 11.4.13, block access to /core/install.php at the web server level, and check for webshells.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: BleepingComputer

tier2.title: 5. Exploited: Abandoned Idunno.AntiCsrf library opens legacy ASP.NET apps to RCE (CVE-2026-131914)

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Application Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: CISA added CVE-2026-131914 (CVSS 9.3) and CVE-2026-132224 (Optimizely Web Experimentation, CVSS 8.7) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. CVE-2026-131914 is an insecure deserialization flaw in the defunct 2008 ASP.NET WebForms library Idunno.AntiCsrf that grants unauthenticated RCE via a single crafted web request.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Because Idunno.AntiCsrf is abandoned, no patch exists; organizations must locate and remove the module from legacy IIS/ASP.NET applications.; CVE-2026-132224 in Optimizely's signup flow was exploited to impersonate users and inject malicious JavaScript into high-profile websites.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: CVE-2026-132224, an Optimizely Web Experimentation vulnerability... and CVE-2026-131914.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Help Net Security

tier2.title: 6. Palo Alto Networks Patches Fragnesia Flaw Used to Root Firewalls

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Network & Perimeter Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Palo Alto Networks issued PAN-SA-2026-0015 confirming that a China-linked threat actor exploited CVE-2026-46300 (Fragnesia), a kernel privilege escalation vulnerability, against internet-exposed management interfaces. Attackers chained PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) with Fragnesia in AI-assisted intrusions to achieve root access on 25 servers.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Exposing PAN-OS management interfaces to the internet remains a primary initial access vector for state-sponsored groups.; Apply the PAN-SA-2026-0015 updates and isolate firewall management interfaces behind strict access controls or bastion hosts.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: A China-linked hacking group chained PHP2Shell with Fragnesia in AI-assisted attacks that hit 25 servers.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: SecurityWeek

tier2.title: 7. Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): a bug in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder can lead to RCE in Jenkins, Jira, Keycloak

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Application & Runtime Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: A critical memory corruption vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) in OpenJDK 17.0.6+ Base64 decoding on x86-64 processors with AVX-512 VBMI support exposes major enterprise Java applications—including Jenkins, Jira, TeamCity, and Keycloak—to unauthenticated RCE or DoS. Red Hat and JetBrains have issued urgent advisories as the flaw's EPSS score surged to 59%.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: The vulnerability specifically impacts x86-64 hardware utilizing AVX-512 VBMI instructions during Base64 operations.; Update OpenJDK runtimes and downstream platforms (such as OpenShift Jenkins 4.15) immediately, or apply JVM flags to disable AVX-512 Base64 intrinsics as a stopgap.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): a bug in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder can lead to RCE in Jenkins, Jira, Keycloak and more on AVX-512 servers.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: #infosec

tier2.title: 8. Bots exploited leaked AWS key from Docker image in under 8 seconds

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Cloud Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Researchers from Stony Brook University planted 300 decoy container images on public registries like Docker Hub and found that automated bots extracted and abused embedded AWS access keys in under eight seconds. Separately, a researcher demonstrated an open-source AI coding agent discovering a decoy financial firm access key and executing an attack chain in under six minutes.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Automated secret harvesting on public container registries outpaces human revocation workflows.; Enforce pre-commit and CI/CD secret scanning to prevent credentials from ever entering container layers.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: A cloud access key left inside a newly published Docker image can be found and used by bots in less than eight seconds.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Help Net Security

tier2.title: 9. Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Cloud & SaaS Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Rackspace is permanently shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after threat actors breached the environment and accessed customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets. Meanwhile, cybersecurity vendor Radware disclosed a separate breach where an unsecured internal Cloud WAF management API exposed customer account details and cloud access keys.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Rackspace Spot customers have until December 8, 2026, to migrate workloads, download data, and rotate all cluster secrets.; Radware Cloud WAF customers must immediately rotate any cloud access keys linked to their accounts.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after a security breach allowed hackers to access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their services.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: BleepingComputer

tier2.title: 10. New Shirudo tool uses AI to shield unpatched Linux systems from exploits

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Defense & Runtime Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Cisco (via Isovalent) and OpenAI released Shirudo, an open-source eBPF Linux runtime tool that allows autonomous AI agents to deploy temporary kernel-level shields against known exploits without service downtime. Simultaneously, Cisco Talos published an analysis of public OpenAI agentic swarm activity to help defenders recognize multi-agent coordination, while the UK NCSC noted a marked rise in AI-assisted attacks since September.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Shirudo uses eBPF to filter out malicious exploit payloads in real time, buying operations teams time to test and deploy permanent patches.; Defenders must adapt to both offensive agentic frameworks (like ARTEX) and defensive autonomous mitigation tools.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: OpenAI and Cisco launched an open-source Linux security tool named Shirudo that deploys temporary runtime protections to block vulnerability exploitation while administrators prepare and roll out patches, without restarting services.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: BleepingComputer

tier2.title: 11. WordPress Blocks Six Backdoored WP Connect Plugins Before Malicious Releases Go Live

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Web & Supply Chain Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: The WordPress plugins team intercepted and closed six WP Connect plugins (CVE-2026-135202, CVSS 9.8, 3,600+ installs) after a suspected developer account compromise on November 22 injected a PHP backdoor (includes/airwp-online.php) fetching payloads from tascredit-pay[.]com. Additionally, Ghostscript patched a critical Type 1 font loader sandbox bypass (CVE-2026-125396 / Upload2Shell) that enables RCE in downstream apps like WordPress and Roundcube via crafted PDFs.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Site administrators using affected WP Connect plugins should remove them immediately, as they remain closed and unpatched.; Update Ghostscript on web and mail servers to mitigate Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396) and apply Roundcube 1.7.7/1.6.22 patches.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: WordPress has removed six WordPress plugins developed by WP Connect after they were backdoored on November 22, 2026, to enable arbitrary code execution on sites that have them installed.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 12. Okta Links ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Threat Intelligence & Identity

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Okta Threat Intelligence and ReversingLabs linked a new extortion brand named INCEPTION (tracked as O-UNC-053) to a large-scale voice phishing campaign targeting enterprise SSO credentials, assessing it is likely a rebrand of ShinyHunters following recent FBI arrests. Separately, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 warned of widespread vishing campaigns by Com-affiliated actors hijacking cloud accounts across US, UK, and Australian financial, legal, and healthcare firms.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Although INCEPTION publicly denied being ShinyHunters, old ShinyHunters PGP keys were used on a new leak site to claim return.; Enforcing phishing-resistant FIDO2 security keys or passkeys completely neutralizes these real-time SSO vishing attacks.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: A threat cluster previously assessed to be affiliated with the ShinyHunters extortion crew may have rebranded and continued operations under a new name called INCEPTION, according to Okta's Threat Intelligence team.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 13. Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Threat Intelligence & APT

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: A newly documented Iran-aligned espionage group, Volant Manticore, is targeting telecoms, airlines, and critical infrastructure in Cyprus using KuboShell, a backdoor that hides command-and-control traffic inside the public InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) P2P network, alongside the Homa post-compromise framework. In parallel reporting, the China-aligned Webworm APT was observed recompiling open-source SoftEther VPN from source to strip standard build artifacts and evade detection.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: APTs are increasingly abusing decentralized protocols like IPFS and custom-compiled open-source tunneling tools to blend into normal traffic.; Monitor for unauthorized IPFS gateway connections and anomalous outbound VPN/tunneling behaviors rather than relying solely on static binary signatures.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Central to the group's operations is a backdoor called KuboShell that uses the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) for command-and-control (C2) and deploys Homa, a post-compromise framework.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 14. Google Patches Critical Chrome Flaw Allowing Sandbox Escape and Code Execution

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Endpoint & Client Security

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Google released an emergency Chrome desktop update (158.0.8127.88) to patch CVE-2026-134401, a critical flaw in the Variations component that allows remote attackers to escape the browser sandbox via a crafted HTML page. Other notable patches released over the past 24 hours include FFmpeg 9.1 (fixing 14 flaws including two critical RCEs), SolarWinds Serv-U 2026.4 (fixing 18 flaws including nine CVSS 9.1 RCEs), Dell Enterprise SONiC 4.6.1 (CVSS 9.9 RCE), and Adobe Experience Manager (CVE-2026-132877).

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Update Google Chrome to 158.0.8127.88+ across all corporate endpoints immediately.; Prioritize patching for internet-facing SolarWinds Serv-U instances, Adobe Experience Manager, and applications bundling FFmpeg.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Google released an emergency update for Chrome to fix CVE-2026-134401, a critical vulnerability in the Variations component. The flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code outside the browser sandbox.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: #infosec

tier2.title: 15. Cisco Expressway RCE (CVE-2026-76466) and ScreenConnect (CVE-2026-84869) Exploited in the Wild

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Vulnerability Management

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: SOCRadar detailed active exploitation of two critical flaws recently added to CISA KEV: CVE-2026-76466 in Cisco Expressway, which grants unauthenticated root RCE on clustered nodes and enabled lateral movement into an internal network, and CVE-2026-84869 in ConnectWise ScreenConnect, where guests joining support sessions can execute arbitrary files on MSP technician workstations in seconds. Additionally, Accenture APEX Labs confirmed Mitel MiCollab flaws (MISA-2026-0012) were exploited as zero-days prior to the November 16 patch.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: MSP technicians using unpatched ScreenConnect clients are at high risk of immediate workstation compromise during live support sessions.; Ensure Cisco Expressway clusters, ConnectWise ScreenConnect clients, and Mitel MiCollab 10.0-series servers are updated and audited for compromise.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-76466, a critical Cisco Expressway flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers root command execution on clustered devices.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: SOCRadar
